name: self-compact
description: Context-driven compaction: Claude calls compact_here when a phase of work has concluded, and an idle session is compacted before its prompt cache expires.

minTokens.title: compact_here: minimum context
minTokens.description: compact_here refuses below this many context tokens (too small to be worth a summary).

idleCompact.title: Compact idle sessions
idleCompact.description: Compact a large conversation that has sat idle, before its prompt cache expires.

idleMinutes.title: Idle minutes before compacting
idleMinutes.description: Minutes after the last turn ends. Keep it under the prompt cache lifetime (60 minutes in Claude Code).

idleMinTokens.title: Idle compaction: minimum context
idleMinTokens.description: An idle session is compacted only at or above this many context tokens.
